annotations.title: Get "About this account" for many users

description: Get the "About this account" data (country the account is based in, username changes, verification) of up to 20 accounts in one call. Returns raw JSON: one entry per handle, in order, plus errors for handles that could not be looked up.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of JSON to return (default 50000). Longer output is cut with a [TRUNCATED] marker. Lower it to save context, raise it if you need the full response.

usernames.description: Accounts to look up, 1 to 20 X handles (a leading @ is fine). Billed as one call per handle.

name: get_user_about_batch
title: Get "About this account" for many users
